documents.text: Toa Domestic Airlines Registration JA8764 Flight origin Okadama Airport Destination Hakodate Airport Passengers 64 Crew 4 Fatalities 68 Survivors 0 Toa Domestic Airlines Flight 63 , registration JA8764 , was a NAMC YS-11A-217 en route from Okadama Airport in Sapporo , Japan to Hakodate Airport . On July 3 , 1971 , the plane left Sapporo Okadama Airport on a scheduled flight at 08:30 .
